note: centre in the 31x28 hand button; dim in code (e.g. 50% dark overlay) while the hero recovers. Empty hand shows that hero's fist (punch 1-2 dmg).
torch_note: A carried torch swings for fire damage (tap). Burnt out = torch_burnt (still swings, no fire). Take/Snuff choice appears when tapping a lit WALL torch.
lantern_note: Wren's lantern hand: prayer_lantern while oil>=1, prayer_lantern_ember at 0 oil (ember only).
